literalIndex.method: Line-indexed Swift string-literal occurrences, intentionally including technical strings to avoid silently excluding app copy. navigationAssessment.emission: Emit ordinary SwiftUI NavigationStack(path:), enum Route with typed associated values, navigationDestination switch, native Tab/TabView with shared labels, and sheet(item:) using typed modal routes. Generate views/handlers at compile time; never evaluate route or UI JSON in app.
navigationAssessment.platformCompatibility: Native Tab on iOS18+ and tabItem fallback on17 are backend compatibility detail. Both consume identical shared route/title/icon values.
requirements: scope stack per shared tab route; sheet own optional stack only when declared
all destinations, titles, toolbars, confirmation copy, dismiss/result handling and deep links declared once
validate route existence/param types at compile time; stable IDs for generated files and collection identity
only shared flows choose initial auth/register mode, authenticated root and post-success navigation
expose native safe-area/navigation styles as typed shared semantics or explicit platform escape hatch, never inferred from app-specific names

migrationAcceptance: Changing one authored label/layout/order/action changes iOS and Android output with no edits to platform screen templates.
Generated screen source traces every text, style constant, route and effect decision to shared IR node or shared service/policy declaration.
No iOS backend special cases for Snap, CameraScreen, InboxScreen, StoriesScreen, FriendMapScreen or AccountScreen.
Existing native integration coverage retained against extracted native adapters; add equivalent shared flow/route tests across both generators.
Audit unexpected app copy/endpoint/polling literals remaining in native backend sources; allow only documented OS/protocol mechanics.
